newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's PM heads to Gaza for talks with Arafat.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's PM heads to Gaza for talks with Arafat.

text.p: Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti left Jordan on Saturday for talks in Gaza with Palestinian Authority President Yasser Arafat, officials said.

They said Kabariti and six other ministers would represent Jordan at a meeting of the Jordanian-Palestinian Higher Committee which aimed ... "to improve the economic situation in the Palestinian National Authority territories."
Arafat is due to return to Amman later on Saturday with Kabariti for a meeting with King Hussein.
The talks, the first meeting of the higher committee in Palestinian self-ruled territory, would also cover increasing trade between Jordan and the Palestinians.

But the officials said latest developments in the peace process would also be discussed, including Israel's decision to build Jewish settlements in Arab East Jerusalem and an Israeli withdrawal from rural areas of the West Bank which Palestinians have condemned as insufficient.
Kabariti was accompanied by his ministers of planning, public works and housing, transport, telecommunications, religious affairs and education, as well as Central Bank governor Ziyad Fariz.
